description: AI attribution this repo never carries: a generated-by footer, a Claude co-author or session trailer, a claude.ai session link. A co-author trailer for a person or a bot account is not attribution: GitHub adds those to squash commits. Matched case-insensitively, per line. Read by .claude/hooks/pre-bash-guard.sh (commits, PR and issue bodies, comments) and scripts/check-attribution.mjs (the PR title, body and commits in ci).
